Subject: Dedicated deployment pricing and single-tenant compliance questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call earlier — we spoke about moving our inference workload to Redwood Dedicated. A few quick details on our end:
- Baseline traffic: ~2M tokens/day across ~140k requests (avg 14 tokens)
- Performance target: 95th latency < 120ms, ideally <100ms for our interactive UI
- Typical concurrent open sessions: 350–500; sustained request rate ~30–50 req/s, with bursts to 80–100/s during market openings
- Models: Two fine-tuned Llama variants (13B) with KV caching; mostly single-turn generations, some streaming for long responses

Key questions before we proceed to SOW:
1) Ballpark pricing for a single-tenant Dedicated pool (private VPC, per-tenant GPU pool) with 12-month committed capacity vs month-to-month.
2) How do you price throughput guarantees and burst capacity (do we pay extra for burst or is it within commit)?
3) Compliance features: KMS integration (customer-managed keys), audit log retention 12+ months, SOC2 evidence package — is there a pricing premium for these?
4) Would Redwood consider sliding the single-tenant premium or amortizing the integration work into a longer commit?

Can you send a short proposal/ballpark numbers so our procurement team has something to review? I can loop Dan (procurement) if helpful.

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Ivanov

Hi Sasha — thanks for the details, that’s very helpful. Attached is a short ballpark proposal (FinArc_Dedicated_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf) — highlights below.

Ballpark options (monthly, USD) for a single-tenant Dedicated pool with private VPC and per-tenant isolation:
- Config A (4x A100-80GB equivalent): list $62,500 / month. Good for lighter footprints; expected sustained throughput ~25–35 req/s for your model mix.
- Config B (8x A100-80GB equivalent): list $112,000 / month. Expected sustained throughput ~55–75 req/s with headroom for bursts to ~110 req/s with autoscale buffer.

Commit discounts (applied to list price): 12-month commit = 18% off list; 36-month commit = 24% off list.

Compliance / single-tenant premium: we typically add a compliance/integration premium to cover KMS integration, extended audit-log retention, and per-tenant observability. Standard premium is ~15% of the committed list price; this covers 12-month audit log retention and a baseline KMS integration.

Throughput guarantees and burst:
- We can contract guaranteed sustained throughput (e.g., 40 req/s) with an SLA for availability and 95th latency, and allow bursts above the commit using a metered burst pool. Bursts above a configured threshold are billed at a reduced overage rate.

Flexible packaging idea: if you sign a 36-month commit we can reduce the compliance premium to 10% and offer a one-time professional services credit to cover initial KMS work.

Next steps: if you can confirm target sustained throughput (e.g., 40 vs 60 req/s) and preferred commit length I’ll circulate a formal SOW and a DocuSign link.

Marissa — quick technical/effort estimate:
- Performance: an 8x A100-80GB pool with our caching profile should comfortably hit sustained 50 req/s for single-turn Llama-13B with 95th latency in the 90–120ms range depending on token length distribution and batching. To target <100ms 95th we should enable continuous batching and higher KV cache residency (increase in-memory cache), which is supported but will slightly increase GPU memory footprint.
- KMS integration: baseline integration to support customer-managed keys for model artifacts + encryption-at-rest + key rotation hooks is ~40 engineer-hours (backend + infra + QA). Assuming blended rate, this is small one-time PS effort but requires coordination with the customer's security team.
- Audit logs & retention: adding 12-month retention on per-tenant audit logs (secure storage + retention policy) is an ops/config effort — minimal ongoing cost but some S3/storage incremental cost.

Commercial suggestion: offer compliance premium of 12% instead of 15% and provide up to $12k of PS credit to cover the KMS integration for a 12-month commit with upfront or quarterly prepaid billing. If the customer wants the 10% premium target, require an upfront 6-month prepay and signature on an accelerated SOW cutover (forces commitment).

Attachment: SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf (internal summary of what we can provide).

Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
